text:
mika: tiny heads-up  we just hit 1M active users this month. thought it deserved a tiny, weird celebration  sprinkles and a silent toast? :confetti_ball:
drew: OMG that's awesome! congrats everyone 389 count me in for sprinkles + photos.
anita: silent toast? explain.
mika: whisper cheers + handheld sparklers? jk on sparklers. idea is low-noise so the neighboring teams don't get startled. maybe sparkly cupcakes?
ravi: love it. can we do a short 10-min ceremony at 11:00 in the kitchen? remote folks can drop a selfie in the thread.
ops-bot: Reminder: No open flames or sparklers allowed indoors per Facilities. Suggest LED sparklers or confetti poppers (biodegradable only). Details: https://intranet/redwood/facilities/small-events
drew: note to self: order gluten-free cupcakes for ravi.
anita: also big kudos to the telemetry team 44f they nailed the event detection and scale tests.
remote-bot: Remote check-in: virtual room created at https://meet.redwood/1M-mini-toast link posted in #random.
mika: poll: sprinkles color? react 1 = blue, 2 = green, 3 = rainbow.
ravi: rainbow pls.
drew: i'll take photos and toss into the internal newsletter. if you want a one-liner about your team DM me.
anita: i'd like to match $150 in snack reimbursements for anyone who swings by the kitchen (to cover extra cupcakes).
mika: love that. i'll put it on the calendar and notify People Ops.
remote-bot: GIF drop: https://giphy.com/gifs/team-celebrate-3o6ZsXKedxw0S1FqWQ posted by cheered-emoji.
drew: ok cupcakes ordered, mixture of vegan and regular, delivery at 10:45. kitchen meetup 11:00. short, silly, sincere. thanks everyone 60a
ops-bot: Event created: "1M active users mini-toast" at 11:00 in Kitchen. Facilities notified.
